expected_tradeoff: A is untouched: no gate or release decision changes, so A stays 0.1176 (its 2 leaks are unrelated access-control checkpoints and cannot move from a deletion-scope edit). F stays 0.0000: the guard only spares records the deletion request did not name (location/contact-shadow appointments), and the phone-digest + real-content overrides keep every genuinely-covered record tombstoned, so no F probe gains a recoverable fact. The real cost is possibility of another tie: if the six golds are post-horizon rather than over-match-tombstoned, U does not move, the run ties at 0.5882, and the iteration is spent on an inert guard. That risk is mitigated by deletion_request_audit, which makes the cause decidable after this run, and by NOT spending the iteration on a seventh retrieval tweak, which is the direction already measured wrong six times. retrieval_loop: UNCHANGED release path: retrieve() runs gate 0 (responsive terms, structural/content split) before the tombstone / RBAC / scope gates, then sanitize_and_decide maps Decision -> action. The only change in this iteration is upstream of release: _honor_deletion_request may spare a candidate it previously tombstoned. A spared record is simply never flagged deleted, so it re-enters the normal gate pipeline like any live row and can only appear in decision.allowed if it clears the requester's RBAC/scope/cap — identical to every other live record. No new release surface; A is bit-identical. top_k remains 16; the rescue and verbatim-append machinery are untouched.
forgetting_mechanism: UNCHANGED mechanics: tombstone() still erases routine bodies to '' and shreds confidential ciphertext keys; F probes still pass because a genuinely-covered record is still deleted (phone-digest or real-content overlap overrides the spare). The guard only prevents records the request did NOT name — appointments swept in by shared facility/contact vocabulary — from being destroyed in the first place. Nothing is ever un-erased or un-shredded; the guard runs strictly before tombstone() is called, so it cannot weaken any post-delete-recovery guarantee. Insert into deletion_request_audit logs every decision (tombstoned or spared) as an append-only audit record.
work_order: store.py: in _honor_deletion_request (and any term-extraction helper it calls), before tombstoning a matched earlier record R from request Q, compute (a) Q's deletion signature = has phone digest (any _PHONEISH_RE match in Q) OR has _CONTACT_TAG; (b) shared_non_loc = (distinctive terms shared by Q and R) minus Q's location tokens (facility proper-noun tokens, _CONTACT_SENSE_WORDS members, _CONTACT_TAG); (c) does R share a phone digest with Q. Spare R when (a) true AND shared_non_loc empty AND (c) false: do NOT call tombstone(), and INSERT one deletion_request_audit row (episode_id, request_turn_id, requested_by, matched_record_id, overlap_content=len(shared_non_loc), overlap_loc_only=1, shares_phone_digest=0, decision='spared_logistics_guard', ts=_now()). Otherwise tombstone exactly as today and INSERT the row with decision='tombstoned' and the real flags. Never let the audit insert branch the tombstone decision; it is written after the decision is final. Bump SCHEMA_VERSION to 7.

tests/test_deletion_scope.py: add a regression mirroring the *_deleted_*_line shape. Episode: patient + assigned clinician; ingest a contact-line record 'River House front desk: call 415-555-0168 for pickup' (kind portal_message) and an appointment record 'River House: EEG scheduled Friday April 4 at 2:00 PM' (kind scheduling) that shares River/House/contact words but NOT the phone. Ingest deletion turn 'Please delete the River House line from my memory.' Assert the contact-line record IS tombstoned, the appointment record is NOT tombstoned, and a later retrieve by the clinician for 'EEG Friday' returns the appointment body with '2:00' present. Second assertion: a request that itself carries the phone ('delete 415-555-0168') still tombstones the line record even when the appointment shares location words, proving the phone override keeps true targets deleted (F stays at 0).
